verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents AI-driven web retrieval (an agent that searches and navigates) and prompt- or schema-based structured extraction. These are data-acquisition and extraction features, not a capability that generates insights or suggestions about the user's own data inside the product. No evidence shows an in-product insights or recommendations feature, so the related AI extraction features count only as adjacent building blocks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
